files.explanation: Byte-identical copy of the pinned pi-mimir file, which also equals the Cursor file. Seven lines by design; it needs no adaptation.

Method, steps and voice rules kept from the pinned pi-mimir file (identical to Cursor). The how and why skills it runs are W4-A, so every line naming them carries a planned W4 marker, and a new paragraph plus step 2 give the interim rule: until they ship, orient and trace the code and its history yourself, say the skills were unavailable, never claim they ran, and keep why's confidence-language rule for your own reasons. The description gains the same marker. Step 5's image-generation tool, which is not a Pi or pi-herdr-agents tool, becomes conditional on the session exposing one, with a mermaid or ASCII fallback that is announced; no tool name is invented. The reply line keeps the threads to chase with how or why and says what to do until they ship.
